info.name: PandaDoc REST API Logs Webhook Events API

params.name: count
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: since
params.description: Return events created on or after this timestamp.

params.name: to
params.description: Return events created before this timestamp.

params.name: http_status_code
params.description: Filter by HTTP response status code group.

items.docs: Returns a paginated log of webhook events that have been dispatched. Supports filtering by event type, delivery time range, HTTP status code group, and error type. Use this endpoint to audit deliveries and diagnose failures.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the webhook event.

items.docs: Retrieves detailed information about a specific webhook event by its UUID, including the full request body sent to the subscriber, the response received, HTTP status code, delivery timestamp, and HMAC signature used for verification.
